ChatContext.description:
Client-provided context identifiers for grounding.

The client sends identifiers for what the user currently has selected.
The server resolves them through tools so the model sees real, current data.
ChatContext.title: ChatContext

ChatMessage.description:
Chat message accepted from the client (AS.04 review hardening).

Only ``user``/``assistant`` text roles are accepted: client-supplied
``system`` or ``tool`` messages could override the grounding rules or
forge tool results. Tool-call payloads are provider-side state and are
never accepted from the client. ``extra="forbid"`` rejects forged fields.
ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage

FieldCreate.description:
``POST /fields`` body (SDD §8.2). ``time_range`` is optional ISO-8601
dates ``[start, end]`` converted to MJD before hitting the gateway.
FieldCreate.title: FieldCreate

schema.title: Response Capabilities Api V1 Assistant Capabilities Get

post.description:
Streaming chat endpoint (AS.04, FR-AS-01/03).

- Validates request and context IDs
- Enforces per-IP rate limit (ORB-AS-002) and global daily budget (ORB-AS-003)
- Requires LLM provider configuration (ORB-AS-001 if unavailable)
- Streams SSE events: token, tool_call, done, error
- Uses read-only tools (list_candidates, read_experiment_results, explain_flags)
- Bounded tool-call loop (assistant_max_tool_iters)

get.description: Original frame cutout at the candidate's predicted position (§8.2b).

Per-frame centroid + aperture photometry along the candidate's track.

Uses each stored frame entry's search-time ``predicted_x``/``predicted_y``
as the prior and re-measures the centroid on the stored array — the
observed positions are quick-look measurements, still ``unconfirmed``.

schema.title: Response Submit Job Api V1 Jobs Post

post.description:
U-07: pre-flight work estimate so the UI can warn before submit.

Only defined for ``moving_object_search``; the estimate uses the same
formula as the handler (``n_motion * n_frames * grid_h * grid_w``)
after applying the handler's own ``frame_window`` selection
(``select_frame_rows``). The background-variant epoch floor may still
reduce the count further, so ``work`` remains an estimate.
